full_judgment: 4. Both the courts below allowed the pre-emption holding that the opposite parties 1-7 purchasers pre-emptees are strangers in the case khatian and the pre-emptors are co-sharers and that the pre-emption is allowable, although the transfer is a Hiba-bil-ewaz as the transferees are not within three degrees of consanguinity of the transferor. But the courts below ignored and failed to find that only the opposite party 8 Korban Ali has some share in the case holding, but other sellers namely, 10-15 had no title or interest in the suit land. So their sale is fictitious. OW 2 has admitted in his deposition that Korban Ali is a co-sharer and it has also been admitted by the pre-emptors that Korban Ali is a co-sharer. So Korban Ali alone had some interest in the case holding, although he had never been in possession of the case land which is situated in a different district.
